query: Consider RROI's Confidentiality Agreement; Does the document allow verbally conveyed information to be considered as Confidential Information?
gold: “Evaluation Material” means all information (including information in the form not only of written information but also information which may be transmitted orally, visually or by any other means) provided to the Recipient by the Disclosing Party or any of its Representatives relating to the Disclosing Party its direct and indirect, subsidiaries and their business, affairs, financial position, assets, operations and activities including, without limitation, information provided for inspection in any data room and all reports, evaluations, notes, analysis, documents, geological, engineering, geophysical and/or land maps or data, financials, trade secrets or any other documents or information pertaining in any way whatsoever to the Disclosing Party and its direct and indirect subsidiaries, together with all analysis, evaluations, compilations, notes, studies or other documents prepared by the Recipient or its Representatives containing or based upon, in whole or in part, such information or reflecting the review of, or interest in the Disclosing Party or the Transaction and includes all information, if any, previously made available to the Recipient or its Representatives; provided that Evaluation Materials will not include any information which:
rag_answer:
Yes.

The Confidentiality Agreement defines **“Evaluation Material”** to include **“all information … transmitted orally, visually or by any other means”** provided by the Disclosing Party or its Representatives. Therefore, information conveyed verbally can be treated as confidential/Evaluation Material under the agreement.

However, it would not be confidential if it falls within the stated exceptions, such as being generally available to the public, already available to the Recipient on a non-confidential basis from an unrelated source, or independently acquired or developed by the Recipient.

judge.gold_summary: 金标证据将“Evaluation Material”定义为包括不仅书面信息，还包括口头、视觉或其他方式传递的信息，因此口头传递的信息可属于协议下的保密/评估材料范围。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答指出 Confidentiality Agreement 中“Evaluation Material”包括“transmitted orally”等信息，因此口头传递的信息可被视为保密信息，并补充了例外情况。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标关键要点，即口头信息可被纳入协议定义的保密/评估材料范围；额外扩写和例外说明不影响命中。
